body:
🔥 FlameSword – Unique Magical Swords for Minecraft

FlameSword is a combat plugin that introduces a collection of powerful swords, each with its own special abilities and lore. From blades that summon lightning to swords that drain life, this plugin transforms ordinary PvP and survival combat into an epic RPG-style experience.

⚔️ Features

15+ Custom Swords with unique powers

Balanced cooldowns to keep PvP fair

RPG-style combat with elemental, magical, and shadow-themed abilities

Works in both survival worlds and PvP servers

Each sword comes with epic lore text

🌟 Example Swords

Voidfang Blade – Launches enemies into the sky.

Infernal Edge – Burns foes and leaves a trail of fire.

Soulreaper Scythe – Steals health from your enemies.

Chrono Saber – Slows time for those you strike.

Eclipse Sword – Switches between fire and ice depending on day or night.
